edgeText.text: Some things just have a little more give.

findings.fix: A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 2 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 2 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "kinetic ®" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "Made to be played with." (screen 1, 100% hidden); "Drag your curiosity" (screen 2, 100% hidden); "Click into something new" (screen 2, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: 2 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "Ripple effect" (0px from the right); "Every action has a reaction." (0px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: Body text is 13px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The margins differ: 22px on the left, 0px on the right, at 390px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.
